mistake_reason: After Britannica’s explosive force was correctly identified (10–15 megatons, commonly cited as ~15 Mt), the InformationExtraction_Expert repeatedly re-executed the exact same Britannica search and page-open steps without changing parameters or incorporating the confirmed result. This unnecessary step repetition (FM-1.3) created a circular verification loop, delayed decision-making, and ultimately led the team to select a conservative 11 Mt value and match to Castle Romeo, instead of using the Britannica-consistent 15 Mt that matches Castle Bravo. The failure arose from the repeated, redundant verification steps that ignored valid outputs.
